title: RUN_DB_TESTS=1 时 packages/base PG 集成测试 32 条红（skill-ops/skills/inspection/im-channels/workdata/bundles/tenancy/approvals）

evidence.note: RUN_DB_TESTS=1 pnpm -C packages/base test：Test Files 10 failed | 32 failed tests（skill-ops 10、skills 4、security-audit 3、inspection 3、im-channels 3、bundles 3、recall 2、memory 2、tenancy 1、approvals 1）
